To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) good governance, as captured by the rule of law and the control of corruption, has a positive and statistically significant effect on growth and on poverty reduction; and (b) less restrictive business regulations are also positively associated with growth and with poverty reduction.

(1) better governance is associated with higher economic performance and lower poverty, and that (2) business regulation matters for economic performance and poverty, while political freedom does not.

(i) good governance, as proxied by the commitment to the rule law, is associated with both higher economic growth and lower poverty, (ii) the degree of business regulations, as proxied mainly by the number of procedures to start a business, is associated with higher economic, growth, but not poverty, and (iii) political freedom is associated with neither economic growth nor poverty.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following question: what policies are needed to promote economic growth and poverty reduction?
the role of institutions and policies for growth and poverty.
the effects on growth of the quality of institutions and the regulatory environment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
good governance, including a strong commitment to rule of law, matters for poverty alleviation largely through its effect in promoting economic growth.

the evidence on the effects of institutions and policies on growth is not yet sufficiently conclusive to warrant any firm policy conclusions, but the evidence on the effect of institutions and policies that affect the private sector is more conclusive, and suggests that the private sector should be given more space to operate.

the quality of governance, the quality of business regulations and policies to support the development of small and medium enterprises (SMEs) are important for economic growth, poverty reduction and the creation of productive jobs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
good governance and policies to facilitate private sector development are important for economic growth and poverty reduction.
institutions matter a lot for economic performance, and that policies that facilitate the private sector are particularly important for growth and poverty alleviation.
good governance and business-friendly policies that promote private sector development are associated with higher growth and lower rates of $1-a-day poverty.
The main takeaway from our work is that
institutions and policies that foster private sector development matter for growth and poverty.
the quality of institutions and policies that promote the private sector matter for poverty reduction and growth, and that the private sector is a key driver of poverty reduction.
institutions and policies that promote the private sector and the rule of law are associated with higher growth and lower poverty.
